subject: Renewal: incremental capacity request & temporary price hold
messages:
From: Priya Menon <priya@olivedynamics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T09:17:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal planning: need extra capacity + price hold request

Hi Irene,

Quick context — Olive Dynamics is coming up on its annual renewal 12/15. Usage has spiked after the new recommendations feature rolled out; we expect an incremental 70% token demand over the next 6 months. Procurement asked whether Redwood can offer a temporary price hold (6 months) while we push a larger commit at renewal.

What we're hoping for: 
- Temporary price hold at current list for 6 months (to avoid a mid-quarter budget hit)
- A short-term top-up of 50% capacity starting 12/1, billed pro-rata
- Bridge credits or a one-time credit to soften true-up exposure

Procurement timeline: PO ready by 12/05 if terms are agreed. Legal will need a short amendment (not a full MSA redline).

I've attached the Q3 usage export for your review. Happy to jump on a quick call this week.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Menon
Head of Cloud Ops, Olive Dynamics
attachments: usage_report_Q3.csv

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Priya Menon <priya@olivedynamics.com>
Cc: David Kim <david@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: need extra capacity + price hold request

Hi Priya — thanks for the note and the export.

High level response: we can do a time-limited price hold in exchange for a short-term committed uplift and a signed amendment. Suggested approach: 

1) Interim uplift: +50% capacity (12/1–5/31) billed pro-rata at current committed rate.
2) Price hold: freeze list price for 90 days post-activation (i.e., 12/1–2/28). We can extend to 180 days if Olive increases committed spend to a 12-month uplift (minimum).
3) One-time bridge credit: USD 15,000 applied against the first true-up invoice if you sign the amendment and provide PO by 12/05.

I'll put together a draft amendment and route internally for approval — cc'ing David and Marissa for pricing and approval timelines. Can you confirm the procurement contact who will send the PO and whether legal needs any specific language (e.g., SOC 2 clause, export controls)?

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
attachments: OliveDynamics_DraftAmendment_v1.pdf

Irene / Marissa — reviewed the usage and the proposed concession. We can approve a temporary concession with the following constraints: 

- Price hold: 90-day guaranteed list price freeze as standard; extendable to 180 days if Olive commits to a 12-month uplift at 1.15x their current committed ARR.
- Bridge credit: USD 15k ok, contingent on PO + amendment signed by 12/05.
- Interim uplift: allow +50% for two billing cycles (Dec + Jan) pro-rated. If consumption exceeds uplift by >30% in any single month, overage rates revert to standard pay-as-you-go for the excess.

Operational ask: CS should configure a KV/prefix cache policy for Olive's high-throughput routes to limit cost. I'll loop infra for the deployment window.

Marissa — approve this commercially? If yes, I'll run legal to final and prep a DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,
David
